verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v1: llāhu ḥasbī lidīnī ḥasbiyā llāhu limā ʾilayhi htimāmī ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v2: likulli bāghi ʿalaynā dāʾimā ʾabadā kadhā liman yaḥsudūnī ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v3: llāhu ḥasbī liman bis-sūʾi kāda binā kadhāka ʿinda mamātī ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v4: waʿinda masʾalatī fī l-qabri dhā faraqi limā qtaraftu dhunūbā ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v5: waʿinda mā nuṣiba l-mīzānu maʿdilaha narjū nabiyyā l-hudā qul ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v6: llāhu ḥasbī ʾidhā mudda ṣ-ṣirāṭu ʿalā matni jahhanama maddā ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v7: llāhu ḥasbiyā lā rabbā siwāhu lahu tawakkulī waʾiyābī ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v8: yā rabbi ṣalli ʿalā l-mukhtāri min muḍari fī ḥaqqihi qultu ḥaqqā ḥasbiyā llāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-allahu-hasbi-c1-v9: kamā tuṣallī ʿalā ʾāli ṣaḥābatihi mā qāla ʿabdu munību ḥasbiyā llāhu
